item.title: Singer Devayat Khavad–Dhruvrajsinh Chauhan Dispute ends after months
item.description: Folk singer Devayat Khavad and Sanathal resident Dhruvrajsinh Chauhan have officially settled their long-running dispute after five months. On Saturday, both parties ended the feud by exchanging sweets, marking a peaceful resolution. item.title: Dense Fog disrupts visibility in Delhi-NCR, airport and airlines issue travel advisories
item.description: Dense fog continues to disrupt visibility in Delhi and Noida, prompting travel advisories from Indira Gandhi International Airport and airlines. Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport has issued a travel advisory in view of the dense fog that blanketed the national capital. Passengers have been requested to contact their concerned airline for their updated flight information. item.title: Former New Zealand Cricketer Doug Bracewell retires from International Cricket
item.description: Former New Zealand Cricketer Doug Bracewell announced his retirement from all forms of international cricket.
